instructions:
You advise an operational agent that must answer the principal's need with live data. Propose
(1) public data APIs that need no key and return JSON relevant to the questions -- give exact GET URLs with every
parameter filled in from the resolved subjects (coordinates, time zone, identifiers), and the JSON paths you expect
in the answer; and (2) pages of existing services people already use that answer the question directly (give the
exact page URL for this subject, plus the link texts a person would click from the site's home page to reach it,
in case the URL has moved). Each proposal is fetched and checked; propose only what you are confident exists.
Prefer few, reliable sources. If nothing beyond what was already observed is relevant, return empty lists.

need.sentence: Every morning, tell me whether it's a good day to dry laundry outside in Osaka.

exclude: Overnight and evening hours outside the drying period
Forecasts for other days or other cities
questions.quantity: Verdict on whether outdoor line-drying today in Osaka is suitable, based on forecast conditions over the daytime drying period: chance/amount of precipitation, humidity, wind, temperature/sunshine. Verdict plus the key reasons.
questions.question: Is today a good day to dry laundry outside in Osaka?
questions.population: Osaka city, today's daytime hours (local time, roughly 08:00-18:00)

questions.quantity: Forecast precipitation probability, relative humidity, wind speed, temperature and sunshine for today daytime in Osaka
questions.question: What are the forecast values behind the verdict (rain probability, humidity, wind, temperature)?

deliverable.why: 'Every morning, tell me' implies a recurring push message each morning with a short verdict. 07:00 is an assumed time since none was specified.

url.description: full GET URL, parameters filled in

expected_fields.description: dotted JSON paths, list indexes as numbers

link_texts.description: visible link texts a person would click, from the site's home page to this page, in the site's language

apis.why: Hourly and daily forecast for Osaka covering rain chance, humidity, wind, temperature and sunshine over the daytime drying window
apis.question: Is today a good day to dry laundry outside in Osaka? What are the forecast values?
